raw_record.question_text: Laura wants to colour in exactly one $2 \times 2$ square in the figure given. How many ways are there for her to do that?

method.method_draft: Inspect the figure as a grid of unit squares. Read the occupied cells in the main figure by rows as: row 1 has columns 1,2,4,5 filled; row 2 has columns 1 through 5 filled; row 3 has columns 2,3,4 filled; row 4 has columns 1 through 5 filled; row 5 has columns 1,2,4,5 filled. Then scan every possible adjacent pair of rows and count adjacent column pairs where all four cells are present: rows 1-2 give 2 such 2x2 blocks, rows 2-3 give 2, rows 3-4 give 2, and rows 4-5 give 2. Total 2+2+2+2=8 ways.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中，image1 显示的是一个由 4 个单位小方格组成的 2×2 正方形；image2 是要计数的主图形，由灰色单位方格组成，可以按 5 行、5 列的位置来读。观察主图形从上到下：第 1 行占有第 1、2、4、5 列；第 2 行占有第 1 到 5 列；第 3 行占有第 2、3、4 列；第 4 行占有第 1 到 5 列；第 5 行占有第 1、2、4、5 列。推理：一个 2×2 正方形必须由相邻两行和相邻两列的 4 个单位方格全部组成。检查相邻行：第 1-2 行中有列对 (1,2) 和 (4,5)，共 2 个；第 2-3 行中有列对 (2,3) 和 (3,4)，共 2 个；第 3-4 行中有列对 (2,3) 和 (3,4)，共 2 个；第 4-5 行中有列对 (1,2) 和 (4,5)，共 2 个。因此总数为 2+2+2+2=8。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is a direct systematic grid-scan method, counting possible top-left positions of a 2x2 block row-pair by row-pair.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to identify the unit-square grid shape and record which cells are present in each row of the main figure. The small 2x2 image clarifies the target block size.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text to know that exactly one 2x2 square must be chosen/coloured and the task is to count the number of possible choices.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the rule that an axis-aligned 2x2 square exists exactly when four mutually adjacent unit cells form a complete 2-by-2 block.
